Step 4: use "Every teammate of Sana is junior." — this fixes: Pallavi is junior; Dev is junior. Step 5: use "Camp North has exactly one senior member." — this fixes: Sana is senior. Step 6: use "Tara is not in Camp Hill." — this fixes: Tara is in Camp River; Tara is junior. Step 7: use "Wamiq and Tara are in different teams." — this fixes: Wamiq is in Camp Hill; Wamiq is senior. Step 8: use "Ishaan and Tara are in different teams." — this fixes: Prisha is in Camp River; Ishaan is in Camp Hill; Prisha is junior; Ishaan is senior. Final arrangement: Camp North: Pallavi, Dev, Sana (S); Camp River: Prisha, Tara; Camp Hill: Wamiq (S), Ishaan (S). Reading off: 2.
